title: NATO Diplomats Fear Trump Could Intensify Pressure on Alliance After Midterms
detail: Citing five NATO diplomats, Politico-derived reporting says European allies worry a Republican midterm defeat could push Trump to escalate criticism of NATO. Three diplomats said he could use the Pentagon's Europe posture review, expected to conclude in December, to withdraw thousands more troops, cut US common-funding contributions or limit the PURL weapons-purchase programme for Ukraine. The warnings are predictions from anonymous diplomats, not a decision; Montenegro's defence minister noted Congress has the final say on troop levels.

media.caption: IBTimes UK: NATO allies fear Trump retaliation after midterms
